reference.liveDeployment: Its gateway process was verified on the authorized Windows host through read-only SSH.
reference.pattern: Paired learner-language and English-gloss lanes keep support at the same focus. NextComp adapts the paired reading pattern to controls and paragraphs; it does not invent word alignment or audio timing.

behavior.enabled: Existing Italian preference remains opt-in and isolated by paired profile/device.
behavior.commonVocabulary: 116 authored Italian control and activity entries are available offline immediately, including common task commands. Unlisted interface labels use the same exact-content Codex cache.
behavior.englishSupport: Italian stays primary; optional English support defaults on within Italian mode. Paragraph glosses are limited to two lines until tapped.
behavior.alignment: Matching paragraph structures pair directly. Different structures use whole-message support rather than guessed alignment.
behavior.commands: Executable command text remains unchanged. Recognized command actions have separate Italian and English explanations.
behavior.code: Backtick and tilde code fences of length three or more retain their exact executable text and appear once; closers must match marker and minimum length. The unaligned English fallback excludes source code fences.
behavior.clientCache: Exact-content translations survive restart inside the same private profile, bounded to 200 entries and 500000 serialized characters. Saving coalesces for 400ms; JSON construction and serialization run off the UI thread from immutable strings, and profile switches cancel stale writes.
behavior.serverCache: A persisted exact source translation is reused under another surface ID within the same device, without a new Codex turn.
behavior.provider: Dynamic translations retain the existing read-only stock Codex ChatGPT worker; API-key login remains refused. No translation API or audio API was added.

validation.physicalUi: Pending release installation; the active phone UI was left untouched.
